subject: SIG initiation + a few boundary/qualification Qs (recap from today's call)
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Anita Shah <anita.shah@finova.com>, IT Security Team <security@finova.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG initiation + a few boundary/qualification Qs (recap from today's call)

Hi Anita / Finova security team —

Thanks for the time today. Quick recap and a small set of clarifying asks so we can kick off the vendor security questionnaire efficiently.

Recap:
- Interest: Redwood supply LLM inference platform for Finova Labs’ document automation pilot (US customers, PHI subset).
- Current ask: Finova's security team prefers a SIG/CAIQ + Finova intake form. You indicated SOC 2 and BAA will be important for procurement.

Clarifying questions (would help our prefill):
1) SOC 2: Which report period do you prefer (last 12 months / most recent FY)? Will you accept a SOC 2 Type II plus bridge letter?
2) Regulatory scope: Do you require full HIPAA coverage (BAA) for the pilot, or just GDPR data residency controls for EU customers? Please confirm both.
3) Data residency: For the pilot will Finova need EU-only hosting for EU customer data, or is US hosting acceptable with appropriate DPA terms?
4) Logs & retention: What is your minimum log retention requirement for audit (days)? You mentioned 90 days on the call — confirm.
5) Preferred questionnaire: You mentioned SIG Lite vs CAIQ — which would you like us to prefill? We can do both, but prefer to start with SIG (full) if that matches your workflow.

Proposed timeline:
- We can return an initial prefill of the SIG answers + SOC 2 summary by Wed 24 Mar.
- Evidence collection (controls docs, config screenshots) by Wed 31 Mar — Marissa will own evidence pulls.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (high-level), sig-prefill-template.xlsx (our suggested prefill format).

Next steps:
- Please confirm preferred questionnaire (SIG / CAIQ / Finova form) and the confirmation on the SOC2/BAA/data residency items above.
- If helpful, let's schedule a 30-min handoff meeting with your IT security reviewer this week.

Thanks,

Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

From: Anita Shah <anita.shah@finova.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: IT Security Team <security@finova.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG initiation + a few boundary/qualification Qs (recap from today's call)

Hi Grace —

Appreciate the summary and the clear timeline. A few quick answers and a small ask on our side:

- SOC 2: We prefer the most recent Type II report covering the last 12 months. A bridge letter is acceptable for items that fall just outside that period.
- HIPAA/BAA: For the pilot we do need a BAA (PHI will be in scope).
- GDPR/residency: For EU customers we require EU-only hosting. For US customers, US hosting is fine.
- Logs & retention: Yes, 90 days minimum for audit logs; 1 year preferred for incident investigations (we can be flexible during pilot but note the preference).
- Questionnaire: Start with the full SIG if you can prefill — that will speed review. After SIG we may ask for some CAIQ items.

One additional ask: please include your subprocessor list and an inventory of third-party libraries/dependencies that process customer data (high level is fine).

I've attached our vendor intake form (finova-vendor-intake.pdf) — please complete any fields that overlap; we'll upload into our procurement portal.

If you can send the SIG prefill and SOC2 summary by Wed 24 Mar that works — let's tentatively plan a 30-min evidence handoff on Thu 25 Mar 10:00am PT, pending confirmation from our IT reviewer.

Thanks,
Anita
Anita Shah
Head of Security Operations | Finova Labs\anitash@finova.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Anita Shah <anita.shah@finova.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG initiation + a few boundary/qualification Qs (recap from today's call)

Hi Anita / Grace —

Thanks for the quick answers. Quick clarifications from our side so we're all aligned:

- SOC 2: We are SOC 2 Type II for Security and Availability; the report covers a rolling 12-month period ending 2026-12-31. We will provide the latest report and a short bridge letter for any controls changed since then.
- BAA: Redwood can sign a BAA for pilot customers. We'll include a standard BAA clause and are open to reasonable edits from your legal team.
- Data residency: We support regionally pinned deployments (US or EU) for customer data. For the pilot, we can provision EU-only hosting for EU customers.
- Logs & retention: Default platform retention is 90 days; we can arrange 1-year retention plans for enterprise customers as an add-on. We will document the retention configuration options in the prefill.
- Subprocessors: We'll include a current list. For libraries/dependencies we'll provide a high-level inventory and indicate which ones process customer content.

Marissa, can you own the evidence pull (screenshots, config exports, ATO docs) and the SIG prefill? Grace — let's confirm the Thu 25 Mar 10:00am PT handoff if that time still works for Finova.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Trust & Security | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

Great — thanks for the confirmations, Anita.

Next steps (confirmed):
- Redwood to deliver SIG prefill + SOC2 summary by Wed 24 Mar (file will be uploaded to the HubSpot record and shared drive).

- Rishi/legal to share standard BAA draft ahead of procurement review.
- We'll include subprocessor list and high-level dependency inventory in the prefill.

I'll send the calendar invite and upload the preliminary files to the HubSpot record (linked below) and to the shared drive. If anything changes on your side, drop a quick note here and we'll adapt.
